completion:

3. Select "Brakes."
4. Select FAIL.
5. Select the cause of failure.
6. Go to "Non-Operating."
7. Choose the reason for why the vehicle cannot drive.
8. If additional info is needed, click on the "Remarks" tab and provide a more detailed explanation of the problem.
